name: region-switcher
title: Region switcher
description: Where you ship to and what you pay in: a country and a currency in one small panel, saved with one button.
docs: countries are { code, name, currency, accepts? } and currencies the currencies on offer (the countries' own by default). The trigger reads 'Ship to NL, EUR'; its panel has a searchable list of countries, a currency choice that follows the country but can be changed, and Save. value is the pair that applies now ({ country, currency }); update it in onSave, or start with defaultValue. Nothing applies until Save, and Escape or a click outside closes the panel and drops what was chosen. accepts lists the currencies an order to that country can be paid in besides its own: a currency outside it shows a hint and cannot be saved. note sits above the button (a free shipping threshold, say). open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange control the panel; a panel that starts open does not take the focus, one the visitor opens does. The component never navigates and sets no cookie: what saving means is up to you. locale writes the currency names and labels holds the fixed words.
